data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=-XJ5O21tWJsQ7kNvgEfoTAN&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA7N-DLQsKSXUJ0vKzzPNruwMqJDy-V-T542EGEHJeQ3A&oe=6761611C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=iXt6E96Ru70Q7kNvgHX8z1e&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAlbTZDR-fQkb8-cupSY9zlVZ5zkDFzuNJ9duDxhePbnA&oe=67616AA4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_mAAc9QUI10Q7kNvgHmIxbk&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAknJ0KEQEG4TQRFD9FI-DLj1hZ5qRcAINHUtBLX-qxlQ&oe=67615207)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=9RuPeyZD-J4Q7kNvgFrPmVi&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBxY9UQ17DGdNf5VnX1kSjFWX58-9Afg2V4clWbsELvfg&oe=676144E6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=oVtBmuo88hMQ7kNvgEiKOL-&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBaofSxX9VHYKJ6-WbdIwDvpZmKAqlEd4xaa0nq4r253w&oe=67617158)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=RxOTpuQLI8wQ7kNvgEZDTpa&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCyblFUJPxGsZamxv4b3CQXQfcIwlWFnVjO4-o4YWqXCQ&oe=67616DD9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NNVzyduLvw4Q7kNvgHXGMvl&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDHSWP47NYHwBmqAiXYl289bFsPoDa6I_4Q4aueK9F8fQ&oe=676153F0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=rnoSJ0J2DTEQ7kNvgE9nag-&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAYagn5cIOg_42l7VSiGiNv_c322p6RD8EwI0q6OMSjDQ&oe=676176AA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=2Hd3VV5fF7UQ7kNvgGDmmJU&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYATTbROTY98TVrl0fEiRJCgagTS2XUyrcKse3G-TEXF1w&oe=67615217)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=4fvb9fCE-vgQ7kNvgGlbSmg&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAePxFL0lgYVXfgI9JjlaQ8Bi39lqx-mURoTsQuq00eHw&oe=67616D8C)
